title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands\-on AI Automation Engineer with experience in n8n, workflow automation, API integrations, and AI/LLM technologies.

You will build intelligent workflows, automate manual business processes, integrate applications, and develop AI\-powered solutions and AI Agents to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and optimize workflows using n8n.
* Develop AI\-powered automations, AI Agents, chatbots, and intelligent workflows.
* Integrate applications using REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, and third\-party APIs.
* Identify manual processes and convert them into scalable automated workflows.
* Integrate AI with CRM, databases, SaaS, and business applications.
* Automate notifications, approvals, data processing, reporting, and follow\-ups.
* Troubleshoot, monitor, and optimize workflows and integrations.
* Collaborate with business teams to identify automation opportunities.

**Must\-Have Skills**

* n8n / Workflow Automation
* REST APIs, Webhooks \& JSON
* AI / Generative AI / LLMs
* AI Agents / Agentic Workflows
* OpenAI / ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Copilot
* JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
* Full Stack development
* End to End Automation

**Good to Have**

* OpenAI API / Azure OpenAI
* Power Automate / Make.com / Zapier
* RAG / Voice Agents
* CRM / ERP integrations
* Docker / CI/CD / Cloud
* Git / Version Control

**Experience**

2–5 years in AI Automation, Workflow Automation, n8n, API Integration, Process Automation, RPA, Software Automation, or related roles.

**Ideal Candidate**

A hands\-on builder who can convert business problems into practical automation solutions and is passionate about AI, AI Agents, automation, and emerging technologies.

**Office Timing:** Monday to Friday: 12:00 to 8:00 PM  
         Alternate Saturday: Working \| Sunday: Fixed Off

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Specialist SDET
description:
We are the most trusted provider of data collection and management, marketing program management, and analytical solutions for our Crop and Animal Health industry clients. With data services at the core—surrounded by an extensible array of streamlined software solutions—our unified platform represents over three decades of innovation and expertise in the agriculture, crop protection, specialty chemical and animal health industries.


Backed by an entrepreneurial, creative and energetic work force, teammates at AGDATA are pushing the boundaries of technology to enhance our relationships with our clients. We are a growing team, focused on adding creative, knowledgeable individuals who are ready to jump right in and make an immediate impact.


Visit us on www.agdata.com


More about us here: https://vimeo.com/347063684

**What’s the role?**


AGDATA is looking for an **SDET** to contribute to the design and building of our software offerings. If you want to have an impact and make a difference, AGDATA may be the place for you.

**Our ideal candidate will have…**

* 7\-12 years of experience as an SDET
* Strong experience of OOP design with **C\#/JAVA programming skill**
* 2\+ years of experience with **Selenium WebDriver and Grid/Cypress/Playwright**
* Ability to write complex **SQL queries** for data validation
* Extensive experience of **data driven testing** and strong experience working with complex data
* Knowledge of test methodologies and their corresponding tools
* Ability to recognize errors and assess risks within applications and or processes
* Working knowledge of any one AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) and experience in integrating AI\-powered solutions into software testing, test automation framework or workflow to improve quality, testing, productivity and efficiency
* Working knowledge with Visual Studio code, Visual Studio 2016\+ and Git
* 1\-2 years of experience with of CI/CD pipelines
* An understanding of the ROI and risk for ah\-hoc testing, test automation, code coverage and feature coverage
* A passion for design, development, and quality

**You will have the opportunity to…**

* Participate in story refinement sessions to ensure the details and dependencies are well defined \& understood with considerations for testing
* Collaborate with Product Owner and Developers as a team to deliver quality
* Writing and maintaining tests cases, executing, and perform ad\-hoc testing with the end\-user experience in mind
* Automate test cases based on priority before the close of the sprint
* Participate in code review to ensure commits are up to standards
* Monitor the Azure Release for regression bugs and or issues with environments
* Work with geo\-distributed teams to coordinate testing of features
* Be vocal during Retrospective meetings and follow up on process improvements
* Managing quality and bugs reports in all stages of releases

**How AGDATA will support you:**

**Supporting your health \& well\-being:**

* Comprehensive medical coverage – up to INR 7\.5 lakh for employee and dependents, including parents.
* OPD benefit – coverage of up to INR 15 thousand covering expenses across specialties.
* Paternity leave up to 14 working days with the option to split leave.

**Emphasizing work life balance:** Flexible hybrid work policy

**Experiencing a work culture that promotes from within:** In 2023, 13% of our associates were promoted internally.

**Being comfortable in the office:** Coming into our brand\-new office space? Free snacks and top class facilities will be available for you.

 *AGDATA is proud to offer equal employment opportunities.*

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know.*

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Key Responsibilities:**


Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test strategies.


Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver in Java.


Design, write, and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well\-structured manual test plans and test cases.


Perform thorough manual functional, integration, system, and regression testing.


Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects and usability issues not covered by formal test cases.


Implement and maintain test automation frameworks (e.g., Page Object Model, TestNG/JUnit, Cucumber BDD) to ensure efficient and organized testing.


Execute automated tests, analyze results, and identify defects, working closely with development teams for resolution.


Integrate automated tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) to support agile development practices.


Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, smoke, sanity and integration testing, leveraging automation where appropriate.


Conduct API testing using tools like Postman or Swagger to validate backend services.


Perform database validation by writing and executing SQL queries to ensure data integrity.


Participate in code reviews of test automation scripts to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.


Provide clear and concise reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall product quality to stakeholders.


Continuously research and implement new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.


Contribute to the improvement of overall software quality processes and practices within the team.


Required Skills \& Experience:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**8\-12 years of experience in Quality Assurance with a strong focus on test automation.**


**Proficient in designing and developing automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver.**


**Strong programming skills in at least one object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#).**


**Experience with test automation frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, Pytest, NUnit, or similar.**


**Solid understanding and practical experience with the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern.**


**Design, write, and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well\-structured manual test plans and test cases.**


Perform thorough manual functional, integration, system, and regression testing.


Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects and usability issues not covered by formal test cases.


Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.


Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.


Knowledge of SQL for database validation.


Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in an agile environment.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


Experience with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber.


Knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).


Experience with security testing concepts and tools.


Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Understanding of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Relevant certifications in Quality Assurance or test automation.


Experience with mobile application test automation.


Education \& Certifications:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.


Industry certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are a plus.

title: Lead Software Automation Test Engineer (Java, Selenium)- 9+ Years
description:
**Position Type :**

Full time**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**Job Title: Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET** .

**About FIS**


Are you curious, self\-motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun.

 **About the Team**


This is an opportunity to join a talented team of functional and technical professionals working on digital banking solutions at one of the world’s leading providers of financial technology solutions. The team works across geographies and collaborates closely to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and reliable products for the financial services domain.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET, who is passionate about quality engineering, test automation, and building robust automation solutions for web, API, batch, and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in automation testing, requirement analysis, test strategy, and Agile delivery.


In this role, you will analyse business requirements, participate in grooming and estimation, design and execute test strategies, identify automation opportunities, build and maintain automation scripts, and help improve product quality based on defect trends and testing outcomes.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Analyse business requirements and actively participate in requirement grooming and estimation.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, quality engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand features and define effective test coverage.
* Develop test strategies, create test plans, and execute test cases for new features, enhancements, and production support scenarios.
* Identify manual test cases that are suitable for automation and develop automation scripts using Playwright, Selenium, and other automation tools.
* Build, maintain, innovate, and continuously improve automation frameworks, test processes, and quality engineering practices.
* Automate testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile channels to improve regression efficiency and product confidence.
* Perform API testing for SOAP and REST services using tools such as SOAP UI and Postman.
* Validate applications through functional, regression, accessibility, mobile, and microservices testing.
* Write, implement, maintain, and review automation scripts and test artifacts.
* Use SQL to construct moderate to complex queries for validating data and troubleshooting issues.
* Participate in Agile development methodologies and sprint ceremonies, including planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track, analyse, and manage defects while recommending quality improvements based on defect patterns and root causes.
* Collaborate across geographies and teams to support delivery, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands\-on testing experience with a focus on automating web and API tests.
* Experience in UI automation testing, API testing, and automation script development and maintenance.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright and Katalon.
* Expertise in automation testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile applications.
* Experience developing or contributing to automation frameworks for enterprise applications.
* Experience on scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, Perl, or similar.
* Strong understanding of manual testing concepts, test scenario design, test case writing, test artifact review, and defect management.
* Experience testing SOAP or REST APIs using SOAP UI, Postman, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with accessibility testing tools and practices such as JAWS and Level Access.
* Experience in mobile testing and web\-based application testing.
* Ability to write moderate to complex SQL queries for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of SDLC, defect management processes, and engineering tools such as Jira, Maven, Git, SOAP UI, Silk Central, BrowserStack, WinSCP, and Putty.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic to complex technical issues and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
**Technical Skills**

**Automation and Testing**

* Playwright
* Selenium
* UI automation
* API automation
* Batch automation
* Mobile automation
* Automation framework development
* Functional and non\-functional test automation
* Test case design and review
* Defect management
* Accessibility testing
* Regression testing
* Microservices testing

Supported by the original testing, automation, framework, API, UI, batch, mobile, accessibility, and microservices expectations in the source profile.

**API and Tools**

* SOAP UI
* Postman
* REST APIs
* SOAP services
* Jira
* Maven
* Git
* Silk Central
* BrowserStack
* Level Access
* WinSCP
* Putty

Supported by the original list of testing, API, defect management, and SDLC tools in the source profile.

**Scripting, CI/CD, and Engineering Tools**

* Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, or Perl
* Jenkins
* CI/CD concepts
* SonarQube
* SVN
* Maven or Gradle
* Checkmarx
* YourKit Profiler
* IBM Heap Analyzer

Supported by the original good\-to\-have skills and tool expectations.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI tools and technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD and Jenkins.
* Experience with public cloud environments such as AWS.
* Experience in penetration testing and performance testing.
* Experience in unit testing and automated functional or non\-functional testing.
* Knowledge of banking or financial domain applications.
* CSTE, CSQA, or ISTQB Advanced Level certification.
* Working experience with Agile development and Test\-Driven Development.
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field.
* 3\-5\+ years of relevant testing and technical experience in a Quality Engineer, SDET, or test automation role.
**Competencies**

* Fluent in English.
* Excellent communicator with the ability to discuss technical and business\-focused solutions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of producing high\-quality documentation.
* Organized approach with the ability to manage and adapt priorities based on client and internal requirements.
* Self\-starter with a team mindset and the ability to work independently as well as part of a global team.
* Strong team player with interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities.
**What We Offer You**


At FIS, we value your expertise and offer growth opportunities, a competitive compensation and benefits package, and a casual work environment. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the transformation of Digital Banking through strong engineering, automation, and quality practices.

**Privacy Statement**


FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**


Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.
